description.narrative: The transaction envisages providing a long-term loan (up to 7-years including up to 2-years of grace period) of up to EUR 25m to the Borrower. The project consists of capex investments for capacity increase and modernization investments in the Company's Manisa facility as well as solar PV investment (the "Project"). The loan will benefit from the limited guarantee provided by Yildiz Holding ("Guarantor"), a prominent conglomerate with diverse business divisions in the food sector, alongside operations in retail and private equity.
